note: Base text Ecclesiastes 1:2 ('Vanity of vanities'). Every quoted verse pasted verbatim from the OLCB (mined); Chrysostom quotes Ecclesiastes, the Psalms, Luke 23:34, Matthew 6:12 and Hosea 6:6. Two flags for the reviewer: 'like smoke are his days' was matched to Psalm 102:3 (whose OLCB reads 'my days') for the smoke image, pasted verbatim; and 'All flesh is grass' was matched to 1 Peter 1:24 rather than Isaiah 40:6-7. Chrysostom's own words to Eutropius are prose, not scripture.
